caption: The drawing features three small, intricately designed container-like objects, depicted with detailed black linework and gold or brownish tones on a light beige background. The uppermost object is a pouch-shaped item, adorned with a chain and a decorative buckle or clasp, outlined in gold and featuring black swirling patterns and a leaf motif inside a shield-shaped decoration. Below and to the left, there is a similar pouch-shaped object without the chain, also outlined in gold and decorated with a symmetrical, black, swirling design with an oval loop at the top center. To the right, there is a teardrop-shaped flask or bottle with a narrow spout, shown in profile, decorated with a similar style of black swirling linework along its surface. Between the two lower objects is a small outline labeled "Exact Size," which provides a reference for the actual scale of the main pouch design. At the bottom left, text reads "COLOR DRAWINGS 4 TIMES ACTUAL SIZE." The artist’s name, "HARRY G. ABERDEEN," is written in the bottom right corner. The overall composition is arranged with ample space between the objects and minimal background detail.
title: Locket for Perfume
